review.evidence: sfrxUSD wrapper/share accounting is separate from base frxUSD minting, which is inherited from frxUSD custodian and Comptroller Safe controls. Safe API confirmed 3/5 threshold, 5 owners, no modules or guard at block 25295194. Re-verified at Ethereum block 25575167 on 2026-07-20: sfrxUSD 0xcf62f905562626CfcDD2261162a51fd02Fc9c5b6 returns asset() = frxUSD 0xCAcd6fd266aF91b8AeD52aCCc382b4e165586E29 and its EIP-1967 implementation slot resolves to 0xaad4a1d92053a62ce7a787641d8b4e5883e96700, so the savings wrapper is a proxy over share-accounting logic rather than an issuance surface. Economic-control adjudication: sfrxUSD shares are minted only against frxUSD actually deposited into the vault and the wrapper exposes no privileged net-claim mint entry point, so its own cap is economically bounded; the unbounded issuer discretion sits on the frxUSD custodian and Comptroller Safe path, where it is scored. As an on-chain ERC-4626-style wrapper there is no separate supply-versus-reserve attestation cadence for sfrxUSD, and no financial regulator supervises Frax. Upgrade path resolved at Ethereum block 25575184 on 2026-07-20: the sfrxUSD EIP-1967 admin slot resolves to ProxyAdmin 0xea0a6ec8114a0af6cf74ca0036ab31d892df13cb (2647 bytes of code), whose owner() is 0xB1748C79709f4Ba2Dd82834B8c82D4a505003f27 — the same Frax Comptroller Safe already recorded as a control on this profile — so the wrapper's share-accounting logic is replaceable by that Safe.
